## 4.1 Description of Trial Design ← §3.1 Overview

*Source: `protocol/synopsis.md` lines 209–213, moved unchanged.*

## 3. STUDY DESIGN

### 3.1 Overview

CTX-NSCLC-301 is a **randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multinational Phase 3** clinical trial. Eligible patients are randomised in a **2:1 ratio** to receive either torivumab 200 mg intravenously every 3 weeks (Q3W) or matching placebo IV Q3W.

## 4.1 Treatment Arms ← §3.5

*Source: `protocol/synopsis.md` lines 284–291, moved unchanged.*

### 3.5 Treatment Arms

| Arm | Treatment | Dose | Route | Schedule | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A (Active) | Torivumab | 200 mg | IV infusion over 30 min | Q3W (Day 1 of each 21-day cycle) | Up to 35 cycles (~2 years) |
| B (Control) | Placebo | Matching volume | IV infusion over 30 min | Q3W (Day 1 of each 21-day cycle) | Up to 35 cycles (~2 years) |

Treatment continues until disease progression per RECIST 1.1, unacceptable toxicity, withdrawal of consent, or completion of 35 cycles, whichever occurs first.

## 4.3 Trial Stopping Rules ← §7.4, the myocarditis stopping rule

*Source: `protocol/synopsis.md` lines 599–599, moved unchanged.*

Immune-related myocarditis is rare (<1%) but carries high mortality with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors. The SMC charter pre-specifies an enhanced review trigger: any confirmed or suspected Grade ≥2 immune-related myocarditis will trigger an expedited unblinded SMC review within 5 business days of notification. A stopping rule will be applied if the incidence of Grade ≥3 myocarditis exceeds 1% in the torivumab arm at any interim review.

## 4.4 Start of Trial and End of Trial ← §3.6 Post-Treatment Follow-Up

*Source: `protocol/synopsis.md` lines 293–297, moved unchanged.*

### 3.6 Post-Treatment Follow-Up

Patients who discontinue treatment for reasons other than disease progression or death will continue tumour assessments per the imaging schedule until progression, initiation of new anti-cancer therapy, withdrawal of consent, or death.

All patients will be followed for survival (Overall Survival follow-up) by telephone contact every 12 weeks following the end-of-treatment visit, until death, withdrawal of consent, or study close-out.

## M11 conformance of this section

- **D14 — treatment arms, the protocol corrected to the SAP (P6, 2026-09-20).** The source's arms are torivumab 200 mg IV Q3W versus placebo, monotherapy. TORIVA's SAP §13.2 describes both arms on a carboplatin/pemetrexed backbone, and a placebo-alone control does not exist in first-line NSCLC: the protocol is the document in error. The moved text above is the source's; the arms this derived protocol *means* — *Torivumab + Chemotherapy* and *Placebo + Chemotherapy*, carried by the USDM's `arms` — are the combination. That the built data agrees is incidental. Disposition in `study/gap-register.md`: fix here. (Before P6 this note said the data was the ground truth; withdrawn by LG.)
- **D15 — randomisation ratio.** The source states 2:1 throughout (§3.1, §3.2, §8.1). Its own header records the shipped data as 1:1 (225:225). **2:1 stands** (P6): the USDM says 2:1 and the alignment check reports the data's 1:1 as a divergence.
- **4.2 Rationale for Trial Design**: the source gives a rationale for the dose (§1.4, PK/PD) and for the endpoints (§6.1 note on assessment frequency), not a rationale for the control type or for the design as a whole. Absent; not invented.
- **Moved 2026-09-20 (review-sheet item 2b, LG's verdict):** randomisation (§3.3) and blinding (§3.4) now sit at **6.7**, where M11 numbers them, not here; the myocarditis stopping rule (§7.4) comes here to **4.3**, from section 7. The one line at 4.3 is also part of the AESI text at 9.2.4 — the single duplicated line in this restructure, because the source states the rule inside the AESI paragraph.
- **4.3 Trial Stopping Rules**: the source has one — an enhanced monitoring and stopping rule for myocarditis, pre-specified in the SMC charter (§7.4). The SMC's own *"stopping rules (safety)"* are a charter item, not stated in the protocol.
- **4.5 Access to Trial Intervention After End of Trial**: absent from the source.
- **4.4 Start and End of Trial Definition**: the source gives the follow-up rule (§3.6) and the timeline (schematic: 18 months accrual, 24 months minimum follow-up), not a definition of trial start and end. Recorded as partial.
